entries.title: A custom connection asks for its fresh check where you start
entries.body: If Firstmate answers from a custom connection whose checks an earlier version made, the start screen no longer asks you to connect a subscription. It names your connection and checks it right there with Check again. Your Firstmate choice and crew slots come back once the check passes, without a restart, and the same happens when you save the connection again from Settings. The start screen's words also stay clear of your last message.

picture.alt: The start screen reading Check Operator gateway again to begin, with what the check covers and a Check again button
